# Steven Kleynenberg — Canonical Publications, Patents & Preprints (SSOT)

> Canonical research archive of Steven Kleynenberg (S.E. Kleynenberg), Founder & Principal AI Architect at Kleynenberg Software Ontwikkeling (KSO, https://kso.kleynenberg.com/) and Kleynenberg Publishers (KP, https://steven.kleynenberg.com/kp/), Delft, The Netherlands.
